feature_events: receive before same-tick forecast, labels and training later, new model activates t+1; read latest available within observation-age TTL; revisions must chain and never change decision snapshots; no retroactive training supplementation
timing: AR(1) x phi .85, y=1.1x+.35e; shared 65% of postwarmup observations arrive 2/5/9 ticks late or not at all; other observations immediate; short abstain TTL0; fading proxy corr declines from 90 to 125; label MNAR shared by arm
groups: joint exogenous latent paths. x AR .35, z,w AR .4. base x, full x/g1/g2, single x/g1. stable coefficient .75 on z; weak .25, reverse -.75, gone 0 after 90; fade .75 to 0 over 90..125. none has no candidate signal. redundancy x+.003 independent noise, partial adds z and a common correlated .8z+.6w reading with .55 effect of w. Interaction target .95zw inaccessible to additive Ridge. Thin partial restricts initial returns to 20. Strict-past lag12 moves group columns together on the same registered decision clock.
fit: R38 fit_version with frozen alpha grid, 24 minimum, window45, periodic updates unchanged. Train Ridge on immutable decision snapshot and then returned labels. Mean trains from all returned labels independently of feature eligibility, preserving label-only negative control and applying a shared comparison mask.

primary.scope: seed-paired MSE over common legal forecast times; nonfade timing vs instant all 120; fade timing vs reference from 125; group full/base, single/base, full/single from 90; joint lag vs full from 90. MNAR only simulated truth/sensitivity.

secondary.scope: pointwise age, MAE/RMSE, arrival-rescued cohort, qualification, cost, and full-vs-observed diagnostics; no abstention price or overall utility claim
